rules.message: ipcMain handler registered outside electron/ipc.cts. Every renderer-facing handler must live in ipc.cts, where the payload is checked, because the renderer is untrusted.
rules.origin: electron/main.cts and ipc.cts header: the renderer is untrusted, validation lives on the main side (ipc.cts, 'The renderer is untrusted'). A handler elsewhere skips the payload and sender checks reviewed there.

rules.message: ipc handler in ipc.cts declares a parameter as `any`. Declare payload args as `unknown` and check them.
rules.origin: ipc.cts convention: every handler arg is `unknown` and checked (NV_BAD_PAYLOAD / NV_BAD_ARGS), see nv:call and nv:exportPdf.

rules.message: A note id or relative path is joined onto the vault root without id_to_path / resolve_within_root / guard_within_vault. A `..` or an absolute path escapes the vault.
rules.origin: vault.rs id_to_path doc: `escape/pwned.md` passed every string guard and wrote outside the vault. provenance_cmds.rs header: `root.join(path)` with an absolute path drops the root, `..` walks out.

rules.message: Raw HTML sink (dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML =, insertAdjacentHTML, outerHTML =, document.write). Note text must go through escapeHtml (toPrintHtml.ts) or be rendered as React text.
rules.origin: Markdown.tsx 'THE HARD GUARANTEE: no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, anywhere' and src/lib/guards/no-raw-html.test.ts; failure ledger F-169 (2026-10-17): report-derived text put into an issue body unescaped.

rules.message: A BrowserWindow hardening switch is turned off (nodeIntegration true, contextIsolation false, sandbox false, webSecurity false). The renderer is untrusted and must stay sandboxed.
rules.origin: electron/main.cts header: `sandbox: true`, sandboxed preload, renderer untrusted. Pinned so a packaging or debugging change cannot silently turn it off (see failure ledger F-146 for what an unverified packaging change costs).
